items.stem: How many litres of a 30% acid solution must be added to 300 litres of a 12% acid solution so that the acid content of the mixture is more than 21% but less than 26%?
items.answer: more than 300 L but less than 1050 L
items.markingKey: Acid = 12% of 300 + 30% of x (1 mark); 21% of (300 + x) < that < 26% of (300 + x) (2 marks); solving: 300 < x < 1050 (2 marks).

items.stem: Solve the system 4x − 8 ≥ 4 and x − 7 < −2, and represent the solution on the number line.
items.markingKey: First gives x ≥ 3, second gives x < 5 (2 marks); common part: 3 ≤ x < 5, i.e. [3, 5) (1 mark).

items.stem: Ananya has ₹2600 and buys 1 file at ₹46 each. With the rest, pencils costing ₹58 each are bought. Form an inequality and find the greatest number of pencils that can be bought.
items.markingKey: 46(1) + 58x ≤ 2600 ⇒ x ≤ 1277/29; x is a whole number, so at most 44.
